Oakville: $18 lunch, 5 years. Guess?

Example only, simple arithmetic:
1) 3 lunches a week x $18 = $54 a week.
2) $54 x 52 weeks = $2,808 a year.
3) $2,808 x 5 years = $14,040.
Assumes no interest and no price changes. It is your money and your choice; the point is to see what small habits add up to when you plan a down payment.
